name: GCS Backup
description: Stores site backups on Google Cloud Storage with a retention policy.
project_description:
The Google Cloud Storage Backup module for Drupal provides a robust and efficient solution for backing up the Drupal site directly to Google Cloud Storage.

 Features 
 - Direct integration with Google Cloud Storage for secure backup storage

- Drush commands for easy backup management via CLI

 Post-Installation 
 You can manually trigger backups using the service GcsBackupManager or the drush commands for more advanced management.

 Additional Requirements 
 - Google Cloud PHP Client Library - A Google Cloud Platform account with Storage access.

 Similar projects 
 While there are other backup solutions available, this module specifically caters to users preferring Google Cloud Storage, offering seamless integration with Google's infrastructure and advanced features tailored for Drupal sites.
